strings.{n} 种智能优化算法求解旅行商问题，实时看路径怎么一代代变短。算法在你的浏览器: {n} optimisation algorithms solving the travelling salesman problem — watch the tour get shorter generation by generation. The algorithms run in your browser (Pyodide, a Python engine for the browser; nothing to install) and no data is uploaded.
strings.选一个算法，设定城市数与迭代次数，点「开始」。右上角 🌙 / ☀️ 可切换夜间/: Pick an algorithm, set the number of cities and iterations, and press “Start”. The 🌙 / ☀️ button at the top right switches between dark and light mode (it follows your system preference and remembers your choice).
strings.左边看路径怎么进化，右边看收敛曲线：红线是全局最优，灰线是当代成本，绿虚线是最近: On the left you see how the tour evolves; on the right the convergence curve: the red line is the global best, the grey line is the current generation's cost, and the dashed green line is the nearest-neighbour baseline (use it to judge how much the algorithm really improved).
strings.采样间隔可选每 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 代取一个点：曲线横轴始终按真实代数: The sampling interval can be one point every 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 generations: the x-axis always uses the real generation number, and sampling only changes the point density, not the result.
strings.想用自己的数据？点「导入数据」上传 JSON [[x,y],...] 或 CSV: Want to use your own data? Press “Import data” and upload JSON [[x,y],...] or CSV/TXT (two numbers per line). The data is only processed in your browser and never uploaded.
strings.想看清细节就拖慢速度或用「单步」；需要配图就点「导出 PNG」（路径图与收敛曲线: To see the details, slow the speed down or use “Step”; press “Export PNG” for figures (tour and convergence curve are exported separately) or “Export JSON” for the raw data.
strings.想横向比较，去 算法对比页：同一批城市交给全站 {n} 个算法跑，曲线叠加、结果: To compare algorithms side by side, go to the comparison page: the same cities are given to all {n} algorithms and the overlaid curves and ranked results come out at once.
strings.口径：城市随机种子 seed=7 · 算法种子 seed=42 · 200 代: Setup: city seed = 7 · algorithm seed = 42 · 200 generations · same random instance · values are the best tour length (lower is better). The benchmark is a uniform random Euclidean TSP — real road networks, clustered or constrained instances behave differently and rankings often flip, so re-run with bench.py yourself. Note: all {n} algorithms are equipped with the memetic 2-opt component (their common footing) — the table compares framework gain; equal values in the table mean several algorithms converged to the same basin of attraction, not copied data.
strings.一句话结论：前十名差距在 2.3% 以内——统计上并列，没有单一赢家（本表为单: In one sentence: the top ten are within 2.3% of each other — statistically tied, with no single winner (this is a single-seed, single-instance teaching comparison: the ranking changes with the seed, so do not read it as a performance league table). Readable trends: the local-search framework trio (VNS / ILS / LK) and ACO and SFLA are regularly in the top tier — the former through the framework gain of “perturb + descend”, the latter because pheromone naturally encodes edge structure. For real production TSP/VRP look at LKH, Concorde, OR-Tools and parallel memetic algorithms, not at any row of this teaching table.
strings.每个算法的「原始形态 → 离散化到 TSP 的映射 → 复用的通用组件」。想做论: For each algorithm: original form → mapping to TSP → shared components reused. If you are designing a comparison experiment for a paper or writing a survey, this table is your index. (The table's detailed cells are in Chinese.)
strings.读表结论：① 「NN 多起点播种 + 步幅上限 + memetic 2-opt」: Reading the table: ① “multi-start NN seeding + step cap + memetic 2-opt” is the trio that lets every population algorithm compete on TSP — each came from a pitfall (reasons on the algorithm pages); ② of the two routes for discretising continuous algorithms, swap sequences are better than random keys across the board; ③ together these components form the scaffolding for developing your own new algorithm.
strings.量级声明（写给要上生产的你）：本页演示是教学规模——城市 ≤150、迭代 ≤20: A note on scale (for those heading to production): the demo here is at teaching scale — cities ≤ 150, iterations ≤ 2000, single browser thread. Real industrial TSP/VRP often has 1k–10k+ nodes, road-network distances, time windows and capacity constraints together; that is the territory of LKH, Concorde, OR-Tools and parallel memetic algorithms. The value of the {n} algorithms here is that you understand the principles, build intuition and learn the “really optimising” check, not that they run your production.
strings.本站按学术影响力决定收录优先级：① 原始论文引用量（Google Scholar: Inclusion priority follows academic influence: ① citations of the original paper (Google Scholar order of magnitude), ② how often later literature uses the algorithm (is it a common comparison baseline?), ③ feasibility and teaching value of discretising it to TSP. Every algorithm included must pass the automatic “is it really optimising?” test (with all local search switched off it must still clearly beat the initial solution, and generation 1 → 200 must show real progress) — a hard threshold. Currently included: {n}.
strings.演示只是这个站的一条线——同一批算法换编码就能解背包、连续函数、多目标、图着色、: The demo is only one line of this site — the same algorithms solve knapsack, continuous functions, multi-objective, graph colouring, bin packing and more just by changing the encoding; see the problem library. Methodology and criticism are in the encyclopedia overview.
